# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `sap-s4hana-cloud` plugin, the opt-in for the SAP S/4HANA Cloud MCP server that Cursor hosts.
- Carries no MCP server definition: the server is Cursor-side, so installing the plugin is the whole configuration.
- Each member enters their own `SAP_S4HANA_API_HOST`, `SAP_S4HANA_USERNAME`, and `SAP_S4HANA_PASSWORD`. These are per-member values, not team settings.
- Logo: SAP's official mark, from `sap.com`.
